objective: GATE 3F-A SOFTRESTAURANT CANARY DESIGN DISCOVERY. Resolver exclusivamente el shape exacto candidato de pago de compra, semantica observable de fecha/enviadoacentral/referencia, lookup post-write determinista, confirmacion por saldo y diferencias entre instalaciones. Solo READ ONLY. No ejecutar canary, no escribir, no implementar Payment Executor.

queries.name: f3a_soft_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3a_soft_payment_shape
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total,SUM(CASE WHEN foliocompra IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS foliocompra_nulls,SUM(CASE WHEN fecha IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fecha_nulls,SUM(CASE WHEN abono IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abono_nulls,SUM(CASE WHEN referencia IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia))='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS referencia_vacia,SUM(CASE WHEN enviadoacentral IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enviadoacentral_nulls,SUM(CASE WHEN foliogasto IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_foliogasto FROM dbo.pagosproveedores

queries.name: f3a_soft_fecha_shape
queries.sql: SELECT MIN(CAST(fecha AS date)) AS min_fecha,MAX(CAST(fecha AS date)) AS max_fecha,COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT CAST(fecha AS date)) AS fechas_distintas FROM dbo.pagosproveedores

queries.name: f3a_soft_enviadoacentral_shape
queries.sql: SELECT enviadoacentral,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.pagosproveedores GROUP BY enviadoacentral ORDER BY enviadoacentral

queries.name: f3a_soft_reference_shape
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total,COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT referencia) AS referencias_distintas,MIN(LEN(referencia)) AS min_len,MAX(LEN(referencia)) AS max_len,SUM(CASE WHEN referencia IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia))='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS referencia_vacia FROM dbo.pagosproveedores

queries.name: f3a_soft_reference_duplicate_groups
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT referencia FROM dbo.pagosproveedores WHERE referencia IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia))<>'' GROUP BY referencia HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3a_soft_purchase_reference_duplicate_groups
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT foliocompra,referencia FROM dbo.pagosproveedores WHERE foliocompra IS NOT NULL AND referencia IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia))<>'' GROUP BY foliocompra,referencia HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3a_soft_exact_tuple_duplicate_groups
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT foliocompra,fecha,abono,referencia FROM dbo.pagosproveedores GROUP BY foliocompra,fecha,abono,referencia HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3a_soft_payment_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.index_id,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique_constraint,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.pagosproveedores') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.index_column_id

queries.name: f3a_soft_balance_views
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS view_name,OBJECT_DEFINITION(o.object_id) AS definition FROM sys.objects o WHERE o.type='V' AND o.name IN (N'AC_vwSaldoCxp',N'vwSaldoCxp') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: f3a_soft_balance_view_columns
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS view_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.AC_vwSaldoCxp'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.vwSaldoCxp')) ORDER BY view_name,c.column_id

queries.name: f3a_soft_related_triggers
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id) AS parent_object,t.name AS trigger_name,t.is_disabled,t.is_instead_of_trigger,OBJECT_DEFINITION(t.object_id) AS definition FROM sys.triggers t WHERE OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id) IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'gastos',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'tempchequespagos',N'movtoscaja') ORDER BY parent_object,t.name

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
NO individual provider, invoice or payment business rows
Only metadata, definitions, aggregate patterns and bounded runtime identity
Connections only through PosRuntimeResolver and get_external_sql_connection
Do not treat referencia as an idempotency key
Do not infer cheque, caja or accounting side effects without direct evidence
Do not authorize any canary or Payment Executor writer
